entries.title: Work in your personal workspace the app could not commit stays open
entries.body: When the app cannot commit what a crewmate made in your personal workspace, such as a panel, the task no longer closes as Built in place. It stays open with the crewmate's files kept as they are, and Firstmate is told why. A new panel appears only once its commit works. The crewmate's next report tries the commit again and closes the task when it works.
entries.noPicture: It shows only when a commit fails, which is rare: the task then stays in Tasks instead of reading Built in place.
